snippet.title: G-Police Game Sample - Playstation
snippet.description:
Original Air Date: May 15th, 2009

G-Police is a rather good mission-based Playstation game with great cutscenes and a solid gameplay engine. You get to destroy lots of stuff but must also be mindful of your surroundings and ocassionally scan things to see if they are a friend or a threat. It was also released for PC. Enjoy.
